caption: Table 62-1. Key nutritional factors for dogs and cats with colitis.*
rows:
Adult dogs: 15 to 30%
Growing puppies: 22 to 32%
Adult cats: 30 to 45%
Growing kittens: 35 to 50%
Option: consider elimination foods or protein hydrolysates (Table 31-5 for dogs and Table 31-6 for cats)

Highly digestible foods: ≥87% for protein and ≥90% for fat and digestible carbohydrate
Fiber-enhanced foods: ≥80% for protein and fat and ≥90% for digestible carbohydrate

Sodium: 0.3 to 0.5%
Chloride: 0.5 to 1.3%
Potassium: 0.8 to 1.1%
*All values expressed on a dry matter basis.
